svg.aria-label: Across calls the agent sends the whole conversation again; each call adds a response and a tool result, so what is sent grows with every call
svg.text: Across calls: the agent sends the whole conversation again, every time
what the model writes in one call. It usually ends by asking for a tool.
the agent program (Claude Code) does what the response asked, on your computer, and keeps
what came back: the text of a file it read, or what a test run printed. The model did not write it.
the agent sends the conversation so far; the model sends back one response.
Dashed blocks are new in each call: the model writes the response (output tokens), and the agent runs the tool to get the tool result.
In the next call both are part of what is sent (input tokens). The bracket shows what each call sends: it grows every time.
Keep going for 200 calls and draw each call's bracket as one thin bar: the columns above become this chart.
one thin bar per call (an illustration: 20k tokens at the start, 150k at the end)
area = all input tokens over 200 calls
